data.long_meaning: Rutvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'rut', which means a path or a course. The suffix 'vik' denotes a chariot, indicating that Rutvik is someone who guides others on their path to success and enlightenment. The name Rutvik carries the meaning “Path of the Chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rutvik usually hope their child will grow to embody path of the chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
